tool_schemas.name: read_file
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full text contents of the file at the given workspace-relative path. It refuses requests where the path is missing, empty, points outside the workspace, or does not exist. It also refuses paths that refer to a directory or to content that cannot be read as text.

remote_path.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

tool_schemas.name: exists
tool_schemas.description: Checks whether the given workspace-relative path currently exists and returns a boolean result. It refuses requests where the path is missing, empty, or attempts to traverse outside the workspace. It may also refuse paths that are not valid for this workspace’s naming and path rules.

remote_path.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

tool_schemas.name: list_dir
tool_schemas.description: Lists the entries under the given workspace-relative directory and returns the full recursive listing. It refuses requests where the directory path points outside the workspace, does not exist, or is not a directory. It may refuse listings when the caller does not have permission to view the directory’s contents.

tool_schemas.name: write_file
tool_schemas.description: Creates or overwrites a text file at the given workspace-relative path and returns confirmation of the write. It refuses requests where the path or content is missing, the path is empty, points outside the workspace, or refers to a directory. It also refuses writes when parent locations cannot be created or when the caller is not allowed to modify the destination.

tool_schemas.name: delete_file
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the file at the given workspace-relative path and returns confirmation of deletion. It refuses requests where the path is missing, empty, points outside the workspace, or does not exist. It also refuses deletion when the path refers to a directory or when the caller is not allowed to remove the target.

metadata.name: ForgeLine QualityOps Vault
metadata.description: A file-backed service for storing and managing manufacturing quality operations records—complaints, weekly QC reports, supplier audits/8D, CAPA and related notes—through simple filesystem-style APIs.
